title: Seshego (map point estimated): 43 learners from one school taken to hospital with stomach illness, reported 16 Oct; cause not confirmed
summary: The Limpopo Department of Health says 43 learners from M.E. Makgato Secondary School in Seshego were taken to hospital with stomach complaints (SABC News, 16 October). Spokesperson Neil Shikwambana said they were taken t...
story: The Limpopo Department of Health says 43 learners from M.E. Makgato Secondary School in Seshego were taken to hospital with stomach complaints (SABC News, 16 October). Spokesperson Neil Shikwambana said they were taken to Seshego, Helen Franz, Botlokwa and WF Knobel hospitals and that 13 were still being treated at Seshego Hospital. Briefly News, 17 October, adds that they were Grade 12 and other senior learners with acute stomach cramps and diarrhoea, that the others had been assessed and discharged, and that no deaths had been reported as of Friday 16 October. The cause is not confirmed: Briefly News reports that health authorities opened an investigation and that no definitive cause had been confirmed. When the learners fell ill is not reported. No learners are named. This is a health alert, not a crime report. Both reports rest on the health department. The map point is estimated: the school is not on the map, so the pin is the Seshego suburb point.
incident: Reported by the Limpopo Department of Health on Fri 16 Oct 2026 (SABC News); when the learners fell ill is not given. The pin date is the report date.
